cases.operation: Apply the real upstream conservation theorem
cases.required_outcome: checked under explicit smoothness and equation-of-motion hypotheses

cases.operation: Omit the equation of motion
cases.required_outcome: unsolved equation-of-motion obligation

cases.operation: Change the theorem conclusion by adding one
cases.required_outcome: type mismatch

cases.operation: Suppress an actual blueprint proof edge
cases.required_outcome: native dependency is still present

cases.operation: Use an unapproved axiom
cases.required_outcome: axiom policy rejects the declaration

cases.operation: Use sorry directly, transitively or with a suppressed annotation
cases.required_outcome: axiom policy rejects all three declarations

cases.operation: Prove affine inverse and residual bound
cases.required_outcome: checked only under the recorded hypotheses

cases.operation: Omit nonzero gain
cases.required_outcome: unsolved gain obligation

cases.operation: Omit the residual bound
cases.required_outcome: unsolved residual obligation

cases.operation: Apply 2 V/mm and 0.5 V offset to 8.5 V
cases.required_outcome: 4 mm and 0.01 mm conditional bound; parameter uncertainty unresolved

cases.operation: Convert 8500 mV and 20 degrees Celsius
cases.required_outcome: same result and compatible temperature

cases.operation: Wrong dimension, outside range, wrong sensor or omitted-offset output
cases.required_outcome: each specific incompatibility is reported

cases.operation: Remove applicability evidence or request a confidence interval
cases.required_outcome: missing condition remains; unsupported uncertainty is explicit

cases.operation: Change method bytes, selected version or model bytes
cases.required_outcome: specific integrity/version diagnostic

cases.operation: Use zero gain or a negative residual bound
cases.required_outcome: each is incompatible

cases.operation: Fail the first prediction and create a tested revision
cases.required_outcome: old assessment retained, only matching applications selected, unresolved alternative retained

cases.operation: Relax the original threshold, with or without rehashing it
cases.required_outcome: original expected protocol rejects the change

cases.operation: Evaluate a mismatched temperature
cases.required_outcome: not applicable; no refutation of the narrow claim

cases.operation: Provide an unrelated model or the original wrong-context model
cases.required_outcome: unsupported or incompatible; original result unchanged

cases.operation: Retry the same measurement after a new model/assessment
cases.required_outcome: same input and executable method; new model reference; remaining assumptions visible

cases.operation: Read the export with the existing JS library and explicitly run exported Python outside the checkout
cases.required_outcome: fields retained and computational output reproduced; formal reports need receiver rechecking

cases.operation: Alter a result payload
cases.required_outcome: digest check rejects it

conditions: Both paths use the same physical quantities, hypotheses, expected results and negative mutations.
Both paths may reuse helpers. Count adapter/schema/authoring/setup work on both sides.
Keep physical validity conditional; compilation, finite observations and a new citation cannot establish it.
Later-use attempts preserve exactly the same measurement input.
Authoring time and total setup cost are not retrospectively measured.
purpose: Fixed inputs and direct-tool source for Gate U; not the Slean module format
